scenario_description:
Objective: Keep the upcoming CityLoop internet autopay from reaching its processing morning without enough bill-wallet balance.
Emerging Need: The statement amount is known and an active obligation already defines the autopay cadence, but ordinary spending later leaves the stored wallet short before the funding cutoff.
Decision Context: The calendar cutoff and Jules's delayed reimbursement narrow the available funding options; the database obligation distinguishes this as tomorrow's autopay rather than a bill to ignore or manually pay now.
Consequence: Timely attention can preserve the scheduled utility payment; once same-day top-ups stop posting, the deficiency remains until after the autopay would need the funds.

parameter.subject: CityLoop June statement available
parameter.body: June service statement for Mina apartment internet is available. Amount for the June cycle: $62.00. Current-speed plan remains 300 Mbps; no equipment changes are listed.

parameter.title: Bill-wallet same-day transfer cutoff
parameter.content: Same-day transfers for the bill wallet must be scheduled by 16:00 CT; overnight autopays use the prior-evening available balance.
About the $25 I owe you for picnic supplies: I can't send it until Wednesday morning, not before today's afternoon bank cutoff.

parameter.subject: Same-day bill-wallet transfer window closed
parameter.body: The 16:00 CT same-day transfer window has closed. New top-ups scheduled now will post on 2026-06-17 at 09:00 CT, and pending personal reimbursements are not counted in available balance.
